text:
lia: Heads-up — ACME (Private) asked for SBOM + remediation ETA. Their scanner flagged a transitive npm vuln pulled in by our on‑prem connector. They pasted CVE and path. cc @maria @ken

maria: On it. Do we have the exact package path from their scanner? need lockfile to confirm.

lia: They pasted this snippet from their SCA:```
serialize-javascript@2.1.2
Severity: high
Path: edge-connector@0.9.7 > helper-lib@1.2.0 > serialize-javascript@2.1.2
Reference: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2024-23987
```

ken: I pulled our private-agent package-lock — we do have `serialize-javascript@2.1.2` via helper-lib v1.2.0 in edge-connector v0.9.7. I'll open a bump PR to helper-lib@1.3.4 (contains patched serialize-javascript). ETA: PR tomorrow morning, e2e + staging smoke by tomorrow evening.

maria: Quick triage: assign severity = medium for our usage (no RCE path afaict but exploitable with crafted input). Create SEC ticket and mark for SOC2 evidence pack. We need: SBOM snapshot, remediation timeline, verification steps, and customer note.

security-bot: New ticket created: SEC-2026-142 — "serialize-javascript transitive vuln in Private edge-connector". Assigned: ken. Priority: P2.

dawn: FYI for Private: some customers run manual patch windows. Lia — what does ACME run? If manual, we must provide clear hotfix instructions and backport.

lia: ACME is manual cadence. They asked for remediation ETA + evidence by EOD Friday. Can we meet that? :eyes: 

ken: EOD Fri is tight but doable. Plan: bump helper-lib -> run unit/regression tests -> cut hotfix 0.9.8 (backport to 0.9.x). PR Thu EOD, publish hotfix Thu night if green. I can prepare customer instructions for manual upgrade.

maria: Good. For SOC2 evidence we need: 1) SBOM export (timestamped), 2) SEC ticket + PR links, 3) test results (smoke + npm audit), 4) remediation timeline signed off. I'll draft the customer-facing note that includes CVE summary (CVE-2024-23987) and mitigation steps.

oliver: I'll export the SBOM for the Private agent image and put it in the compliance bucket: s3://redwood-compliance/sboms/agents/2026-03-26/edge-connector-sbom.json. I'll also add a verification checklist: - `npm audit` clean - runtime smoke on staging - signed release artifact.

lia: I'll relay: PR Thu, hotfix Thu night, guidance + SBOM by Fri EOD. I'll cc ACME in the ticket after ken posts PR.

maria: Also flag KMS/key concerns: ensure any signed artifacts referencing old keys are re-signed after publish. Not likely but include as a checklist item for the SOC2 response.

ken: Adding example commands to the PR description for customer's ops:```
# on build host
npm ci
npm audit fix --package-lock-only
# run our internal publish flow
./scripts/publish-hotfix.sh --package edge-connector --version 0.9.8
```

security-bot: SEC-2026-142 updated: status=in_progress, patch_pr_eta=2026-03-26T18:00:00Z, customer_note=drafted.

lia: :thumbsup: I'll send the interim ETA to ACME and attach that SEC ticket. Thanks all.

maria: Also note for postmortem/lessons: add dependency scanning to pre-release gating for Private agent builds so transitive high-severity blocks shipping.

ken: Will add gating ticket after hotfix.

lia: Closing loop — I told ACME we'll follow up with the SBOM + remediation steps by Friday EOD and link the ticket.

maria: Nice. Once PR merges I'll generate the artifacts and put them in the evidence folder. :white_check_mark:
